checks.text: The page shows the heading "Emoji Picker" and the text "No favorites yet" in the Favorites tab.
Typing "smile" in the search field labelled "Search" shows a result list containing the item with the label "Smiling face" and the emoji "😀".
Clicking the button "Copy" on the result item labelled "Smiling face" copies "😀" to the clipboard and shows the text "Copied" next to that item.
Typing "heart" in the search field labelled "Search" shows a result list containing the item with the label "Red heart" and the emoji "❤️".
Clicking the button "Add to favorites" on the result item labelled "Red heart" moves that item to the Favorites tab, and the Favorites tab shows a list item containing "Red heart" and "❤️".
In the Favorites tab, clicking the button "Remove" on the list item labelled "Red heart" removes that item, and the text "No favorites yet" reappears.
Typing "smile" in the search field labelled "Search" and pressing the key "Enter" copies "😀" to the clipboard and shows the text "Copied" next to the first result item.
Clicking the button "Copy all" in the Favorites tab after adding "Red heart" and "Smiling face" copies "❤️😀" to the clipboard and shows the text "Copied all".
Reload keeps the favorite "Red heart" in the Favorites tab with the emoji "❤️".
